utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help with the repair drive—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thank you, Leo. If you can help gather a few tools and ask around for spare parts, that would mean a lot.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Absolutely—I’ll gather the tools and ask around for spare parts today.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can help, but I’d want to know the timing and what kind of repair supplies we need first.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Yeah, that sounds right — can you confirm the timing and the supplies first?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Sure — once I know the timing and the supplies, I can plan around it and help properly.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—the repair drive. I must’ve missed the details; what still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I’m a bit hazy on the list too, but I think we still need to sort the drop-off boxes and label the donations. I can check and tell you what’s left.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Oren. Let me know what’s left, and I’ll help with the boxes or labels.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I can help spread the word about the repair drive, and I’ll repeat the plan to anyone who asks.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That’d be great, Vik — thank you. I’ll keep sharing the details while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll keep repeating the plan around the neighborhood too.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Gus, sorry I’m late — what’s the latest on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No worries, Dane — we’re still on track. I’ve got my tool kit ready, and folks are bringing in a few extra fixes this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Great, glad to hear it. I’ll swing by and help where I can—just point me to the next fix.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’d like to keep it simple: tell me the date, the time, and what I should bring for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Sure — it’s this Saturday at 10 AM, and please bring gloves and any basic hand tools you’ve got.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Great, thanks. I’ll be there Saturday at 10 with gloves and my hand tools.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, what’s the repair drive for, exactly?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: It’s for helping folks fix up things around the neighborhood—small repairs, tools, and supplies people might not be able to manage on their own.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it—who can use it, and what kind of repairs are covered?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m glad we’re doing the repair drive — it’s a great way to help folks and bring everyone together. Want me to help spread the word or sort out what still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, please help spread the word, and I’ll sort out what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word and keep folks posted. Just let me know what still needs doing when you’ve got it sorted.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thank you, Mara — could you help me keep a sign-up list and check in with neighbors about what needs fixing?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I can keep the sign-up list and check in with neighbors about what needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got a little stock set aside for the repair drive—what do you still need?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Cleo — I can use whatever you’ve got handy, especially screws, duct tape, or small tools.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can spare some screws and duct tape, and I’ve got a small screwdriver set too. I’ll bring them over right away.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Rey, I heard the repair drive is getting organized, and folks are already dropping off tools and supplies. If you want, I can help spread the word around the block.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Tess. I’d appreciate that—just let people know we’re still gathering tools and supplies.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely — I’ll tell folks we’re still collecting tools and supplies for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it — I’ll double-check the details before we do anything. What’s the first thing you want me to verify about the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Please verify the date and drop-off time first, so I can make sure it fits around school pickup.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’ll check the date and drop-off time first. Do you want me to confirm them for the repair drive now?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good—what’s the main thing I need to know about the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Mostly just bring any broken stuff you want fixed, and I’ll help sort the rest when I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — I’ll bring a few broken things by when I can.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll spread the word about the repair drive and make sure folks know the details.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Vik—that’d be a huge help. I’m counting on you to get the word out.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll tell the neighbors and keep everyone in the loop.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, the repair drive? I might’ve missed the details—what’s the plan again?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: It’s mostly a drop-off for tools and supplies folks can spare. I can go over the details if you want.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, please—I'd appreciate a quick rundown so I don't miss anything again.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’ll stop by and see what still needs fixing. If you’ve got a list, I can help with it.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: That’d be a huge help, Rey. I’ll write up a list and set it aside for you.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sounds good — I’ll check in later and take a look.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks for checking in, Opal — I’m keeping the repair drive list updated and can coordinate the next round of fixes. If you hear of any homes that need help, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Of course, Rosa — I’ll keep an eye out for any homes that need repairs and send them your way.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Wonderful, Opal — I appreciate it. I’ll keep the list current and loop folks in as soon as we have a crew ready.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can help, but I’m a little worried about the timing and where everything will be stored. Do we already know who’s coordinating pickups and drop-offs?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I can check with the group and get you a clear answer on pickups and drop-offs. I’ll also ask where we’re storing everything so you’re not left guessing.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, that would help a lot. Once you know, please send me the pickup plan and storage spot so I can work around it.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, this is the repair drive we talked about, right?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, let me double-check the details first so I don’t mix it up.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks—please confirm the details, and then I’ll know it’s the right repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Let’s keep it simple: I can help with the repair drive if we make a clear list and time. Tell me what’s needed, and I’ll stick to the plan.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good, Eli — I’ll help put together a clear list and a time that works.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good, that works for me. Send me the list and time, and I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard the repair drive’s getting underway—what’s the latest on what folks still need?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: We’re still short on screws, duct tape, and a couple of hand tools. If you hear of anyone with extras, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it — I’ll ask around and pass along anything I find.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh—right, the repair drive. I’m happy to help; just remind me what still needs doing, and I’ll pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Oren — we still need someone to sort the tool table, label the donated parts, and help greet folks at the door.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing — I can sort the tool table and label the donated parts. I’ll also help greet folks at the door if you still need me.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help with that—what time does the repair drive start, and do we need to work around school pickup?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: It starts at 3:30, so we should be fine after pickup.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, that works for me. I’ll plan to head over after pickup and meet you there.
